description_en: Queries a list of versions of files to be deployed
description_zh: 获取待发布的文件版本列表
name: ListDeploymentPackageFiles

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The workflow ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173945.html operation to query the workflow ID by name
parameters.help_zh: 业务流程的ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173945.html接口，根据名称查询对应业务流程的ID
parameters.name: business_id

parameters.help_en: The start date for committing. Specify the date in the yyyy-MM-dd format
parameters.name: commit_from

parameters.help_en: The end date (included) for committing. Specify the date in the yyyy-MM-dd format
parameters.help_zh: 提交截止日期（包含），格式yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: commit_to

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who commits the file
parameters.name: commit_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the code for the file.

The code for files varies based on the file type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600169.html. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212428.html operation to query the type of the code for the file
parameters.help_zh:
文件的代码类型。

不同文件类型其代码不同，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600169.html。
您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212428.html接口，查询文件的代码类型
parameters.name: file_type

parameters.help_en:
The change type. Valid values:

0: addition

1: update

2: deletion
parameters.help_zh:
变更类型 
0：新增
1：更新
2：删除
parameters.name: change_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the files to be queried
parameters.name: file_ids

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

DeploymentPackageFiles.description_en: The list of files pending deployment
DeploymentPackageFiles.description_zh: 具体的待发布的文件版本信息列表

items.description_en: The details of the version of the file to be deployed
items.description_zh: 具体的待发布的文件版本信息

ChangeType.description_en:
The change type, which is an integer. Valid values:

0: addition

1: update

2: deletion
ChangeType.description_zh:
Integer变更类型 
0：新增
1：更新
2：删除

CommitTime.description_zh:
提交时间

格式为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，例如 `2025-04-10 15:55:47`；该示例不包含时区标识

CommitUser.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the user who committed the file

CommitUserName.description_en: The name of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the user who committed the file
CommitUserName.description_zh: 提交人的阿里云账号名称

FileName.description_en: The name of the file of the current version
FileName.description_zh: 生成本次文件版本的文件名

FileType.description_en: The file type. The code for files varies based on the file type. For more information, see [DataWorks nodes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600169.html）
FileType.description_zh: 文件类型。不同文件类型其代码不同，详情请参见[DataWorks节点合集]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600169.html）

IsSameAsProductionVersion.description_en: Indicates whether the version is a version in the production environment of the scheduling system
IsSameAsProductionVersion.description_zh: 该版本是否是当前调度生产上的版本

NodeConfiguration.description_en: The scheduling property configurations of the node that corresponds to the file, which is a JSON string
NodeConfiguration.description_zh: 保存该文件所在调度节点的调度属性配置信息（Json串的形式保存）

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the auto triggered node that corresponds to the file
NodeId.description_zh: 该文件对应的调度上的节点id

SmokeTestStatus.description_en: The test status in the development environment

Status.description_en:
The status of the code file of the current version. Valid values:

2: Commit check in progress.

3: Commit check passed.

4: Commit check failed.

10: Committing.

11: Committed.

20: Approved.

21: Rejected.

22: Warning detected during checking.

23: Under code review.

24: Code review rejected.

80: Deployment package created.

100: Deploying.

101: Deployed to the production environment.

200: Cancelled
Status.description_zh:
该版本的代码文件的状态 
2：提交检查中
3：提交检查成功
4：提交检查拒绝
10：提交中 
11：已经提交至调度的开发 
20：审核通过
21：审核失败
22：检查存在告警
23：代码审核中
24：代码审核拒绝
80：创建发布包成功 
100：发布中 
101：发布至生产 
200：取消

UseType.description_en:
The module to which the file belongs. Valid values:

NORMAL: The file is used for DataStudio.

MANUAL: The file is used for a manually triggered node.

MANUAL_BIZ: The file is used for a manually triggered workflow.

SKIP: The file is used for a dry-run node in DataStudio.

ADHOCQUERY: The file is used for an ad hoc query.

COMPONENT: The file is used for a script template
UseType.description_zh:
文件所属的功能模块。取值如下：
NORMAL：数据开发。
MANUAL：手动任务。
MANUAL_BIZ：手动业务流程。
SKIP：数据开发的空跑调度。
ADHOCQUERY：临时查询。
COMPONENT：组件管理

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足条件的数据总条数

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于出现错误后排查问题
